description: This file defines the Runtime and ExecutionContext classes for managing debugging, console message handling, and remote object management within a Firefox environment, likely as part of a developer tools or debugging infrastructure.

classes.name: Runtime
classes.description: Manages debugging sessions, console message listening, and execution contexts for a Firefox debugging environment.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript execution context, providing methods for evaluating scripts, managing remote objects, and handling bindings.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string.

methods.name: executionContexts
methods.description: Returns an array of current execution contexts.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an expression in a specified execution context.

methods.name: callFunction
methods.description: Calls a function in a specified execution context.

methods.name: getObjectProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of an object in a specified execution context.

methods.name: disposeObject
methods.description: Disposes of a remote object by its ID.

methods.name: createExecutionContext
methods.description: Creates a new execution context associated with a DOM window or global object.

methods.name: findExecutionContext
methods.description: Finds an execution context by its ID.

methods.name: destroyExecutionContext
methods.description: Destroys an execution context and cleans up associated resources.

methods.name: evaluateScript
methods.description: Evaluates a script string within the context.

methods.name: evaluateFunction
methods.description: Evaluates a function with arguments within the context.

methods.name: addBinding
methods.description: Adds a binding (function) to the context global.

methods.name: unsafeObject
methods.description: Returns an unsafe reference to a remote object by ID.

methods.name: rawValueToRemoteObject
methods.description: Converts a raw JavaScript value to a remote object representation.

methods.name: _instanceOf
methods.description: Checks if a debugger object is an instance of a specified class.

methods.name: _createRemoteObject
methods.description: Creates a remote object descriptor from a debugger object.

methods.name: ensureSerializedToValue
methods.description: Serializes a protocol object to its value form.

methods.name: _toDebugger
methods.description: Converts a JavaScript object into a debugger-compatible object.

methods.name: _serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object via global stringify.

methods.name: disposeObject
methods.description: Deletes a remote object by ID.

methods.name: getObjectProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a remote object.

methods.name: _getResult
methods.description: Processes a completion value, extracting result or exception details.
